user_story: As a user, I want to be prevented from registering with an already-used email so that duplicate accounts are avoided.

positive.title: Successful registration with a unique email
steps: Fill in the other required fields
positive.expected_result: User account is successfully created and a confirmation message is displayed

negative.title: Failed registration with an already-used email
steps: Enter an email address that is already registered
Fill in the other required fields
negative.expected_result: Registration fails and an error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use

edge.title: Registration attempt with email in different case
steps: Enter an email address that matches an existing account but with different casing
Fill in the other required fields
edge.expected_result: Registration fails and an error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use
